lines.text: Honest moment. My battles don't look as good as they should.
So I'm slowing every fight down, frame by frame, to find out why.
Does the hit really land? Or does it swing at the air? Does anyone flinch?
Is there a wind-up before the blow? And when they fall... does it feel heavy?
Next comes the fix. Stronger poses, real impact, deaths with weight. And I'll show you the before and after.
So tell me. What makes a hit feel good?
